## Purpose

Describe the user-visible problem and the intended outcome.

## Evidence

- [ ] Format, lint, strict types, unit tests, build, and verification pass.
- [ ] Keyboard, reduced-motion, and responsive behavior were checked where relevant.
- [ ] New media, fonts, or dependencies have provenance and license evidence.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, private deployment identifiers, or copied reference assets are included.

## Review notes

List changed routes, known limitations, screenshots, and rollback considerations.
